info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Disputes-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Disputes API enables users to access and manage utility billing disputes efficiently. Through this endpoint, consumers can retrieve a comprehensive list of disputes related to utility billing, empowering them to understand, investigate, and resolve billing issues effectively. This API is designed for utility companies, customer service representatives, and developers who require access to billing dispute data for reporting or operational purposes. It enhances transparency and collaboration in dispute resolution processes, ultimately leading to improved customer satisfaction.
